import numpy as np
base = {'1':np.ones_like(A),'A':A,'A2':A**2,'1/A':1/A,'1/A2':1/A**2,'logA':np.log(A),'expA':np.exp(-A),'sqrtA':np.sqrt(A),'A3':A**3}
def tryfit(names_f, names_g, p=2):
    cols=[base[n] for n in names_f]+[base[n]*t**p for n in names_g]
    X=np.column_stack(cols)
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dA_dt,rcond=None)
    r=dA_dt-X@c
    return np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dA_dt), np.round(c,5)

from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def run(fams, lin, npar, starts):
    def model(p):
        X=np.column_stack([f(p) for f in lin]+[fam(p) for fam in fams]+[t**2/A])
        c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dA_dt,rcond=None)
        return dA_dt-X@c, c
    best=None
    for p0 in starts:
        try:
